name: Thanos snap
description: Snap your fingers and turn to dust. Snap again to come back.
origin: Avengers: Infinity War (2018). Thanos snaps his fingers and half of all life turns to dust.
whatHappens: A snap, a beat of silence, then you turn ash-grey and crumble into dust that drifts away, leaving your empty room behind. Snap again and you re-form in a warm golden shimmer. You also come back by yourself after 20 seconds.
how: Snap your fingers (thumb and middle finger) where the camera can see your hand. The mic listens for the snap to confirm it.
tips: Keep the snapping hand in view, around chest height.
Snap for real: thumb and middle finger together, ring and pinky folded. Without a mic, that shape plus a clear release still works.
